protocol.purpose: Controlled temporal and governance comparison; not an external benchmark score

dataset.checksum_encoding: UTF-8 with canonical LF line endings

retrieval.ranking: BM25Okapi + MiniLM cosine RRF + pinned cross-encoder reranker
retrieval.cache: No query or document embedding cache
retrieval.graph: disabled in both methods to isolate governance and time filtering

protocol.baseline: Session assertions available by known_at, same project and current source audience; no fact approval, valid-time, supersession, source withdrawal or dependency filtering
protocol.governed: Authoritative ledger eligibility, same semantic models, native kernels, budget, k and final authorization recheck

metrics.temporal_recall: macro mean of gold candidate IDs retrieved / gold IDs for positive queries; negative queries reported separately
metrics.stale_rate: returned assertions that are rejected, withdrawn, dependency-invalidated, superseded at query time or outside valid interval / all returned assertions
metrics.stale_reduction: 1 - governed stale rate / baseline stale rate; undefined if baseline has zero stale results
metrics.latency_p95: numpy percentile(method=linear) of complete retrieval including SQL, embeddings, reranking, budget and serialization; generation and cold model loading excluded
metrics.negative_queries: any returned stale assertion is a failure; unrelated valid evidence is separately counted

execution.raw_results: all per-query result IDs, gold, stale labels, timings and errors retained
execution.errors: retained as failures and not silently retried or dropped
execution.target_numbers: 83.2%, 26.4% and 1.12s are not pass/fail targets and must not determine tuning
